limits: Whole bounded corpus and per-owner memory snapshots in existing schema v1; not database-native vector search.
Fixture-model tests exercise actual concurrent SQL connections, CAS, memory lifecycle, corruption refusal and bounded admission. They are not native quality evidence.
Native source generation and extraction are actual Qwen3-4B API requests. Review, edit, erasure and attempted replay are explicitly local operator actions.
Each backend passed 10 native controls. SQLite used 477 input/57 output and PostgreSQL 476 input/57 output tokens over two requests each. Explicit API prices/cap0; hardware/electricity/chat excluded.
Visible short preference/source and host-authored corpus; no blind/held-out factual, extraction or semantic retrieval benchmark.
Erasure removes current live values and retains tombstones, not historical backups/transcripts or cryptographic physical page erasure.
SQL skill/embedding ledger, app/CLI/UI backend selection, identity/RBAC, durable quota/queue/workers and service load remain unfinished.
Knowledge backup adds corpus/source-session/tombstone cold comparisons; does not back up external files/skills/embedding ledgers or accept whole-app migration.
No model weights/binaries/databases/dumps/private fixture credential values are included in this source artifact. No goal completion, main publication or framework ranking claim.
